BASE.name: Base Enterprise Technology
BASE.description: Applies to all in-scope enterprise technology.

UK-DATA.name: UK Personal Data
UK-DATA.description: Activate for UK GDPR / Data Protection Act / DUAA-regulated personal data processing.

EU-AI.name: EU AI Act
EU-AI.description: Activate for AI systems or GPAI within EU AI Act territorial/material scope.

EU-NIS2.name: EU NIS2
EU-NIS2.description: Activate for essential/important entities in Member States transposing NIS2.

EU-DORA.name: EU Financial Services — DORA
EU-DORA.description: Activate for financial entities within DORA scope and relevant ICT third-party arrangements.

UK-FS.name: UK Financial Services Operational Resilience
UK-FS.description: Activate for firms within FCA/PRA operational-resilience rules and related supervisory expectations.

UK-NIS.name: UK NIS / Cyber Resilience
UK-NIS.description: Activate for operators/digital providers under current UK NIS rules and track the Cyber Security and Resilience Bill as it progresses.
sources: Cyber Security and Resilience Bill when/if enacted

PAY.name: Payment Card
PAY.description: Activate for environments handling account/cardholder data within PCI DSS scope.

US-PUBLIC.name: US Public Company Cyber Disclosure
US-PUBLIC.description: Activate for SEC registrants subject to cyber incident and governance disclosure requirements.
sources: SEC cybersecurity risk management, strategy, governance and incident disclosure rules

US-HEALTH.name: US Health — HIPAA
US-HEALTH.description: Activate for HIPAA covered entities/business associates handling ePHI.

CA-OSFI.name: Canada — OSFI Technology & Cyber
CA-OSFI.description: Activate for federally regulated financial institutions subject to OSFI B-13 and related guidance.

SG-MAS.name: Singapore — MAS Technology Risk
SG-MAS.description: Activate for financial institutions subject to applicable MAS technology-risk notices/guidelines.
sources: MAS Technology Risk Management Guidelines and applicable Notices
